cases.task: In boltons.iterutils, windowed and windowed_iter accept non-positive window sizes (size <= 0), where size=0 silently yields no windows and negative sizes fail later in itertools.tee. Reject every non-positive integer size (<= 0) with ValueError mentioning window size at call time, consistent with chunked using _validate_positive_int. Preserve positive size sliding window behavior and fill options. Add regression tests to tests/test_iterutils.py and run that file.
